ana: Quick flag 0: onboarding marlin-lite-8b from community repo. License has 'non-commercial' + attribution clauses. Can we offer a quantized serving-only variant?

priya: Paste the exact clause? small wording changes matter.

ana: Copied: ```
Use: Non-commercial research only. Commercial use or redistribution of model weights is prohibited. Attribution to the authors and link to LICENSE required for any product use.
```

priya: From our 4-bit GPTQ run on dev: MMLU -0.9 pts, latency ~2x improvement, safety regressions negligible so far. If legal allows serve-only, we can gate quant variant to Dedicated-internal only.

tom: Ops: we'll need to block artifact-downloads and scrub any public buckets. Also ensure backups are encrypted and access audited.

legal: Short answer: API-serving that does not distribute binaries is allowed under that wording, but commercial use prohibition is important. If a customer gets the binary (customer-hosted Dedicated), that's likely forbidden unless we negotiate a license exception. Attribution as proposed is fine. Recording memo to compliance tracker.

ops-bot: Added ingest rule: deny_export when metadata.license=="NC-1". PR: https://git.internal/infra/artifacts/+/451.

deploy-bot: Staged quant build deployed to staging-gpu: https://ci.example/builds/7123.

ana: Thanks. Action items: Priya run full eval and prompt diffs, Tom enforce export block & audit, legal finalize memo and exception path, I'll prepare short canary plan (internal only). Keeping thread open until canary RFC merged.
